meta.aciklama:
Comment "EDITOR" and I'll DM you the link to the free Claude skill that edits your videos right on your own computer. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: how it works, and the catch.

1. It gives Claude 42 editing tools: cut, join, silence removal, reframe to vertical, captions, overlays, loudness and platform exports.

2. Ask in plain words. Say cut the silence and make it 60 seconds for Reels, and Claude runs the tools.

3. Captions can pop word by word, placed clear of TikTok and Reels buttons.

4. Claude looks at a contact sheet of its own edit and checks the file against each platform's specs before it reports back.

It's free and open source (MIT, past 4,000 GitHub stars). It works offline, with no API key and no account.

The catch: you need Claude Code, ffmpeg and Python, so you work in the terminal. Captions from speech need a free local speech engine installed separately. It runs the cuts, but you or Claude still decide what stays, so watch the result.

For the link, comment "EDITOR".

#claudeai #claudecode #claude #claudetips

transkript.t: Someone built a Claude whose only job is editing your videos, past 4,000 stars.
That's because it gets 42 editing tools right on your own computer.
So you say, cut the silence, and the dead air disappears.
Then you ask for captions, and they pop up word by word.
But here's the part that's even crazier.
Claude looks at its own edit before you do.
And it's a free github repo, and nothing gets uploaded.
